column1: # tests/expected/ctl_caught_debt.tsv — #369's MIGRATION LIST (14z-224; maintainer-ruled 2026-11-08 "A1, B1, c1", C1:
# the rule lands at once, with this shrink-only list). One gate basename per row: every gate whose header declared a
# MUST-FIRE mode at 8464fa3f (the tree before #369) and does not yet print `CONTROL CAUGHT:` through
# tests/lib/controls.sh vs_ctl_caught. A listed gate keeps the pre-#369 behaviour: tests/lib/classify.sh reads its
# mode run's FAIL as HONOURED without positive evidence, and vs_ctl_fired prints its line under a mode.
# tests/test_ctl_caught_lint.sh FAILS on a row whose gate calls vs_ctl_caught (migrated: delete the row), declares no
# mode, is gone, or did not exist at 8464fa3f (a new gate never joins the list), on a row that is not on this list's
# first version (blob pinned in that gate as ORIGIN_BLOB) and on every committed version since (a deleted row never
# comes back), and on a mode-declaring gate that is neither listed nor calls vs_ctl_caught. Migrate a gate (docs/project/must_fire_contract.md § #369), then delete its
# row in the same commit. #369 and #310 CLOSED with these rows left, as #369's stated limit (ruled 2026-11-13, 14z-227,
# the maintainer: "agreed on both"; DECISIONS_HISTORY.md "Ruled 2026-11-13 (14z-227) — #369 and #310 close"): no batch
# migrates them; a listed gate that is migrated for its own reasons still leaves the list in that commit.
